items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 71:1
items.html: (To the question) For the Yesod of the Nukva is not fit to raise MAN for the sake of the GAR of souls, except by that spirit that her husband casts into her in the first union, which ZA gives in the secret of the coupling of back to back, called the 216, and called male Hassadim, because they are drawn from the stature of the AB of the Mazal. See above in Answers 60 and 70, where this is explained at length. And sometimes they are called male Gevurot, namely when only the aspect of the MAN alone is considered. And these she receives at the time ZA is back to back; but at the time of her return face to face with ZA, her Partzuf is corrected not in the aspect of the male MAN of the Mazal, but only in the aspect of feminine Gevurot, which are drawn to her from the Malchut of Ima, which is feminine MAN. See there in Answer 70. (Item 78).
